title: Hearing on NYCHA and PACT repair work order delays
summary: The Council's Public Housing Committee held an oversight hearing examining NYCHA's work order system used to track and complete repairs at both traditional public housing and PACT-converted developments. The hearing reviewed NYCHA's persistent repair backlog, which stood at about 602,000 open work orders in August 2026, with average completion times rising to 477 days, and examined ongoing mold, lead paint and heating repair issues under a 2019 federal agreement with HUD. Testimony was expected from NYCHA officials, residents and advocacy groups.
